summary: Service demo/frontend is reporting high latency due to requests targeting a non-existent port (9899) on the backend service.

root_cause.explanation: A configuration change in the frontend deployment (revision 44) updated the backend-url argument to point to port 9899 instead of 9898. The backend service is running and listening on port 9898, causing the frontend to time out while trying to reach the incorrect port.

evidence.fact: The frontend container logs show repeated 'backend call failed' errors with 'context canceled' when attempting to connect to 'http://backend.demo.svc.cluster.local:9899/echo'.
The backend pod log shows it is running and listening on port 9898.
The frontend deployment revision 44 changed the --backend-url argument to use port 9899.

impact: High latency in frontend service due to failed backend calls.

next_steps.action: Revert the frontend deployment configuration to use port 9898 for the backend URL.
